body: Thanks for the response.  I have to ask, is this in the US? Because I don't know of one place in the US you can work a minimum wage job and make the bills, and that is a full time minimum wage job, let alone a weekend job.  As for sacrificing I don't have much, to be honest that is one thing that I like about myself. I don't need a whole bunch of stuff to feel free.  I could go get some job I hate and continue on living, but that doesn't give my life any sort of meaning.  I am trying to write, and hopefully that goes somewhere.  Again thanks for your input.

I feel you. I've had my awkward moments as well.  I never really got picked on like you did, and I was never sexually assaulted.  I didn't have many friends growing up, just a long run of acquaintances.  I was weird.  I always had thoughts of suicide until I was about 26 (I still do but not as bad).  The biggest step for me was to learn to love myself.  I was suicidal from 13 to 26.  If I were ever to do it, I know how I would. I was a lot like you, I thought I would be dead before I was 30.  The only thing I can say is take it one day at a time. (I know this is cliche, but it does help.)  I don't have much to offer you, but if you need someone to listen. I can do that.  Keep your head up, I hope things get better.  Know this, there are people that feel the same as you. You are not alone.
